interpretation_limits: Each input is a separate CLI process stream; ordinals are process-local and do not identify a test, user, case or request payload.
Stage durations are inclusive and may overlap. Do not add parent and child buckets or compare their sum with wall time.
completed and count mean a measured call settled, whether it returned or threw; they do not mean a successful business operation.
active = started - completed describes calls still in flight at that event; their unfinished durations are absent from total_ms and max_ms.
Mode aggregates use only the end snapshot once per profile. An abort snapshot is cumulative evidence at that instant, not another completed profile.
choice.capture is inside choice.save; runtime surface buckets are inside their root bucket; auth.sql is inside auth.read; canonical digests may be nested in any of these.
The HTTP root timer includes handler admission and finalization. It does not measure browser receipt or prove an HTTP response, persisted choice or test success.
The abort event is the server Request.signal observation; absence does not prove that the browser did not abort. post_abort_until_end_ms is server continuation only.
An absent stage is merely not observed in the supplied log; a missing end or active work at end remains explicit.
This is diagnostic-only evidence and supplies no nominal acceptance fragments.

diagnostic_findings.J1: All nine original installed UI steps passed on D18, including actual choice response loss, same-intent replay and retained history after a real Planner source change. This is diagnostic evidence only.
diagnostic_findings.J2: Requests GET returned 503 before the original form assertion. No financial mutation, proposal, approval, MI07/M31, Apply or unique receipt recovery was reached.
diagnostic_findings.J3_J4_J5: The three other original UI journeys passed on D18; no nominal credit is transferred.
diagnostic_findings.P14_stored_result_root: HOLD: two historical result reads total 402.058 ms inclusive, only about 4.95% of the first choice handler; this is not evidence that adding read roots solves the nominal17 UI abort.

limits: D18 is a diagnostic overlay on clean W17/P13 and C53 plus terminal105 receipts; it is neither a clean nominal nor integrated target evidence.
All five original identities, UI actions, assertions and budgets are preserved; no seed or direct mutation replaces the journey.
Inclusive stage durations overlap; never sum them as exclusive CPU or equate handler duration with browser HTTP latency.
Returned handler outcome alone does not establish a business success. The separate original UI assertions establish the observed diagnostic J1 outcome.
The configured UI abort remains 10000 ms and the per-test budget remains 180000 ms.
Restore or remove all seven instrumentation paths before a clean nominal. D18 adds zero criterion fragments.
The financial503 does not identify which admission precondition failed. The separate formal approval contract gap remains a static owner finding.
